Independent review of run r-20260929T072932526739-srw-ingest-tick-module at head c24a0f2347fa657daa500d65f9fe0e2971aa161a against base 41ef8974aee89b85dc8cd941454ec20ca1a8fc6d. The node builds the scheduled ingest as its own module: imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_ingest.py (278 lines) exposes tick(index, directory, previous=...) as one pass with no clock and no loop, run(index, directory, cadence=...) as the scheduled loop that carries the source fingerprints between ticks, and a main entry point that names the index it writes explicitly rather than defaulting to the reader's cache path. tests/test_telemetry_ingest.py (232 lines, 11 tests) is the second deliverable, and a 32-line evidence fragment is the third.

Goal fidelity. All four test properties the brief names are asserted and green at the head. A tick over two fixture receipts appends every row and an immediate second tick appends none (rows_inserted 3 then 0, sample_count held at 3, files_read 2 then 0, files_skipped 2). A tick opens no source unchanged since the previous tick, counted by patching Path.open, and the reviewed node's own negative-control log is red at exactly that assertion. An index rebuilt from the receipts equals the appended index row for row, compared as values over the window with the appended side asserted non-empty. And no receipts file is opened for writing, with an explicit precondition that the record was read, so the write check cannot pass vacuously. The declared cadence is 5.0 s, matching the plan's recorded decision. The fingerprint is (inode, size, mtime_ns): size catches an append, mtime catches a same-length rewrite, and the inode makes a roll that repoints the live name at a fresh file read rather than mistaken for the bytes the old name held.

Independent verification. This review re-ran the declared gate at c24a0f2347fa657daa500d65f9fe0e2971aa161a in a scratch tree that is a git archive of the head, under the shared project interpreter with module.__file__ printed inside the tree: 58 passed (11 ingest + 47 index), EXIT=0; the serving-interpreter parse guard 1 passed, EXIT=0; ruff check imas_ambix tests All checks passed. The base arm at 41ef8974aee89b85dc8cd941454ec20ca1a8fc6d, driving the reviewed test file against the base tree, fails only by collecting the module that revision does not contain (ERROR tests/test_telemetry_ingest.py, ModuleNotFoundError), while the base tree's own index suite and parse guard pass (47 passed; 1 passed): the change adds no failing test, so added_failure_count is 0 with no added ids. The reviewed run's own after-arm log (gate-tests.log, 58 passed) carries no FAILED or ERROR line, so both derivations agree. This review then applied two mutations of its own in a scratch copy. The first, if known.get(key) != fingerprint replaced by if True in pending_sources, turned 4 of the 11 tests red, the declared one among them: the tick's filter has teeth. The second, report = index.ingest(pending) replaced by report = index.ingest(states) with the counters left filtered, left all 11 tests green, because the index's own _consumed_whole_and_untouched skip keeps opens at zero: the suite cannot tell the hand-off set from the tick's own account of it. A probe also measured that a Path.open patch records 0 calls for one sqlite3.connect while the same counter records a real tick's read (1 open on the first tick, 0 on the next), which is why the never-opens-the-reader-cache-index assertion cannot fail for a module that connected to that path.

Scope and records. The change is one coherent commit over exactly the three declared paths (module, test, fragment; 542 insertions, no deletion), with no plan file or plan meta line touched, no figure for its own fragment, no stray artifact, and a clean worktree at the reviewed head. The commit carries a body, states the mechanism, names no plan or ticket, and has no AI trailer. Three findings beyond that. The module docstring's line 31 states a system property this commit does not deliver: the index is still written by readers, because watch.py:715-716 and :758-759 each call index.ingest on every read against DEFAULT_INDEX_PATH (watch.py:64), so plan section 5's reader half is a later node's work. run(iterations=0) ticks once rather than zero (measured: 1 report), because the break test runs after the tick and only a negative count is refused. And the delivered manifest ends mid-key at evidence_inputs: [ with no follow_ons or blockers, names a third test log that does not exist, and carries no baseline_suite or after_suite: the worker's own final record names that repair as pending and its process ended before the repair, and the write-time audit that should have caught it returns no findings on that file, so the read-path annotation reports this run's added-failure count as unmeasured. This review supplies the two arms that record lacks from its own gate logs.
